dedupe_keys.name: reinforced concrete intermediate short column failed in shear

description: Reinforced concrete intermediate short column failed in shear is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Pu-Wen Weng, National Center for Research on Earthquake Engineering (ncree.narl.org.tw). Eight intermediate short columns were tested in the NCREE Taipei Laboratory. The tests aimed to investigate the seismic behavior of intermediate short columns in shear failure cases with different combinations of structural parameters, such as height-to-depth ratio, transverse reinforcement ratio, and axial load ratio. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: force-transfer mechanism, intermediate short columns, load-displacement curve, shear deformation, shear failure. Published 2025-07-31. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
